current_suggestion.pitch: Your poker diet is heavy on GTO solver content, but Galfond brings elite high-stakes live and online experience with an unusually honest, introspective lens — he talks openly about mental game, tilt, variance, and the psychological side of poker that GTO Wizard and GTO Lab don't cover. He also ran the famous Galfond Challenge, which produced real high-stakes heads-up data worth studying. Format is a mix of solo reflections, strategy breakdowns, and occasional interviews, typically thoughtful and long-form.
